title: REQ · Backend module with YAML config, slog logging and health endpoint
summary: Go module, config loader with env overrides, slog logger, Chi router with health endpoint
description: Context: no Go module exists in backend/. Desired behavior: backend/go.mod (Chi, yaml.v3), configs/config.example.yaml, a loader applying env overrides for token secret and Git/hosting settings, slog JSON logger, and a Chi router exposing GET /healthz. Expected result: the server can be constructed from a config and answers health checks. Why: every later endpoint needs config and routing.
acceptance_criteria: Given configs/config.example.yaml, when loaded, then server address, auth and git fields are populated
Given env STORYFORGE_TOKEN_SECRET and STORYFORGE_GIT_TOKEN, when loading, then they override YAML values
Given GET /healthz, when called, then status 200 and JSON {"status":"ok"} are returned
Given a config missing auth.token_secret, when loaded, then an error is returned
